lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task: plan: the error-audit correction guide

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to plan before computing anything.

items.prompt: A theater sold 24,861 tickets in week one and 18,957 in week two. How many total?

steps: Add each place, regrouping as needed.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: a school had 62348 visitors expected, but only 59255 attended. How many fewer people attended than expected?
a stadium raised 56339 dollars on Saturday and 22137 dollars on Sunday. What was the total number of dollars raised?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will figure out, how, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: a stadium had 348366 visitors expected, but only 191887 attended. How many fewer people attended than expected?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: a fundraiser raised 456415 dollars on Saturday and 215303 dollars on Sunday. What was the total number of dollars raised?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
